title: Complete REVERSE method coverage
description: Verify and, where needed, fix SSH reverse-forward configuration, remote address fallback, TCP-only behavior, port conflicts, lifecycle, and reconnect.
acceptanceCriteria: REVERSE rejects unsupported UDP and validates remote listen/local service ports
Generated `-R` argv exposes the remote listen port and binds/falls back to the intended foreign host
Start/stop/restart/reconnect/cleanup and port conflict tests pass
A reverse tunnel is not labeled running when OpenSSH/GatewayPorts prevents external reachability; the diagnostic explains the distinction

steps.details: Extend existing tests for empty host fallback, wrong direction of `-R`, UDP rejection, conflict, failure, cleanup, and unreachable listener semantics.
Read `config/reverse.ts`, SSH builder/runner, engine planner, and current reverse tests; identify concrete gaps.
Correct only evidence-backed config/state/diagnostic behavior, preserving the existing schema and API.
Run focused tests, custom harness, typecheck, and lint; record real SSH/GatewayPorts VPS evidence separately.

technicalNotes: README must continue to explain `GatewayPorts clientspecified`; a process being alive is not proof of public reachability.
